fusions.name: Scalding Clasp
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in a burning grip that deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Pour
fusions.desc: Pours a narrow, steady stream of flame that deals 7 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, with a 50% chance to set each [Burning] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cauterizing Touch
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Unshaking Aim
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
